description: Agent-based social adoption model on a dynamic contact network with policy broadcasts and social influence. The model simulates daily adoption dynamics driven by peer effects, personal traits, and policy messaging, with network rewiring via homophily.

modules.name: NetworkDynamics
modules.description: Generates the initial social network and updates it daily via homophilous rewiring and clustering preservation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  # Build initial graph with target degree distribution and clustering
  deg_seq <- sample_negative_binomial(mean=degree_mean, dispersion=degree_dispersion, size=N)
  G <- configuration_model_with_closure(deg_seq, clustering_bias)
  apply_homophily(G, attributes=[age_group, ses], strength=homophily_strength)
else:
  # Daily rewiring to maintain homophily and assortativity
  for each edge e in sample_edges(G, fraction=rewiring_rate):
    (u, v) <- e
    if should_rewire(u,v, homophily_strength, adoption_assortativity=assortativity_target):
      w <- sample_node_similar_to(u, by=[age_group, ses, adopted]) not connected to u
      rewire_edge(G, (u,v) -> (u,w))
# Update degrees and average degree signal
signals.graph <- G
signals.degrees <- degree(G)
signals.average_degree_daily <- mean(signals.degrees)
notes: Configuration model with triadic closure to achieve clustering_bias.
Homophily applied on age_group and ses; adoption assortativity is nudged via rewiring decisions.

modules.name: PolicyBroadcast
modules.description: Broadcasts policy messages to agents, updating perceived signals, awareness, and trust in response to information and misinformation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day % message_frequency == 0:
  targets <- select_targets(agents, targeting_strength, criterion=non_adopters_first)
  reached <- sample_subset(targets, fraction=policy_channel_reach)
  for agent i in reached:
    misinformation_factor <- 1 - misinformation_fraction
    signal_i <- message_intensity * trust_policy_i * misinformation_factor
    signals.policy_signal_by_agent[i] <- signal_i
    awareness_i <- min(1.0, awareness_i + 0.2)
    # Trust update towards signal alignment
    trust_policy_i <- clamp(trust_policy_i + trust_update_rate * sign(message_intensity) * (1 - misinformation_fraction), -2, 2)
  signals.messages_sent <- len(reached)
else:
  for agent i:
    signals.policy_signal_by_agent[i] <- 0.0
  signals.messages_sent <- 0
notes: Targeting prioritizes non-adopters; tie-breakers by low awareness.
Trust is bounded to avoid divergence; awareness saturates at 1.

modules.name: InteractionScheduler
modules.description: Samples daily active contacts from the underlying graph and generates exogenous random meetings.

notes: Edge sampling approximates daily interactions without simulating all edges.
Random meetings introduce weak mixing beyond the graph.

modules.name: InfluenceAndAdoption
modules.description: Computes adoption probabilities from social, personal, and policy signals; updates agent adoption states with optional disadoption.

update_rule.pseudocode:
signals.adoption_updates <- []
# Compute neighbor influence per agent from active edges
for agent i:
  neigh <- neighbors_in_edges(signals.daily_active_edges, i)
  if |neigh| > 0:
    frac_adopted <- mean(adopted[j] for j in neigh)
  else:
    frac_adopted <- 0
  social_term <- social_influence_weight * (frac_adopted - threshold_i)
  trait_term <- personal_trait_weight * openness_i
  policy_term <- policy_signal_weight * signals.policy_signal_by_agent[i]
  fatigue_i <- max(0, fatigue_i - fatigue_decay)
  logit_p <- base_adoption_logit + social_term + trait_term + policy_term - fatigue_i + RNG.normal(0, noise_scale)
  p_adopt <- sigmoid(logit_p)
  if adopted_i == 0 and RNG.uniform() < p_adopt:
    adopted_i <- 1
    last_adopt_day_i <- day
    fatigue_i <- fatigue_i + 0.1
    append(signals.adoption_updates, (i, 1))
  else if adopted_i == 1 and RNG.uniform() < disadoption_rate:
    adopted_i <- 0
    append(signals.adoption_updates, (i, -1))
notes: Threshold encodes individual resistance; social influence compares neighbor adoption to threshold.
Fatigue reduces adoption propensity; resets slightly upon adoption.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables for calibration and evaluation; applies optional smoothing and reporting lag.

update_rule.pseudocode:
raw_adoption_rate <- mean(adopted_i for i in agents)
raw_new_adopters <- sum(1 for (i, delta) in signals.adoption_updates if delta == 1)
raw_messages <- signals.messages_sent
raw_avg_degree <- signals.average_degree_daily
# Apply smoothing and lag
adoption_rate_series.append(raw_adoption_rate)
new_adopters_series.append(raw_new_adopters)
messages_series.append(raw_messages)
avg_degree_series.append(raw_avg_degree)
adoption_rate_out <- moving_average(adoption_rate_series, window=smoothing_window).lag(report_lag_days).last()
new_adopters_out <- moving_average(new_adopters_series, window=smoothing_window).lag(report_lag_days).last()
messages_out <- moving_average(messages_series, window=smoothing_window).lag(report_lag_days).last()
avg_degree_out <- moving_average(avg_degree_series, window=smoothing_window).lag(report_lag_days).last()
# Emit observables
observable.adoption_rate_daily <- adoption_rate_out
observable.new_adopters_daily <- new_adopters_out
observable.policy_messages_daily <- messages_out
observable.average_degree_daily <- avg_degree_out
notes: Smoothing is causal (uses past window only) and lag simulates reporting delays.
Observables are emitted once per day.

algorithms.ConfigurationGraphWithClustering: Generates a configuration model graph from a degree sequence and adds triadic closures to reach target clustering.
algorithms.HomophilousRewiring: Edge rewiring process that prefers linking similar agents by attributes and nudges adoption assortativity.
algorithms.DailyActiveEdgeSampling: Samples a fraction of edges to represent daily interactions plus Poisson random exogenous contacts.
algorithms.TargetedBroadcast: Selects non-adopters preferentially and broadcasts messages with specified reach and intensity, incorporating misinformation.
algorithms.LogisticAdoption: Adoption probability computed via logistic model combining social, personal, policy terms, and fatigue with noise.
